jobs.title: League City Job:Armored Truck Driver And Messenger(Full-time)
jobs.description:
Opportunity in League City

Job Title: Armored Truck Driver And Messenger (Gig/Contract) Hiring Organization: GardaWorld Based in: League City, TX (a vibrant local hub)

Salary: $24-$30/Hour (approx. $57.1k/Year) Benefits: A competitive compensation package is offered. Join our League City team for this flexible role.

Core Focus

Core objectives involve your professional skills in Security And Financial Logistics.

  • This League City-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our GardaWorld team in League City, TX is growing.
  • Benefit from working in League City, a key hub for the Security And Financial Logistics industry.

About GardaWorld

GardaWorld is a global champion in security services, integrated risk management, and cash solutions. We protect the high-value assets of financial institutions, major retailers, and government agencies worldwide. We offer our employees a robust, highly secure working environment where discipline, integrity, and safety are the highest operational priorities. We pride ourselves on hiring professionals who thrive in high-stakes environments.

A Timeline of Your Daily Operations

  • 6:00 AM - Secure Dispatch: Arrive at the heavily fortified GardaWorld vault facility. You will arm yourself, review the daily manifest with your partner, and conduct a rigorous mechanical and security inspection of the armored commercial vehicle.
  • 7:30 AM - Tactical Routing: Navigate the armored vehicle safely through dense city traffic or suburban routes. You must maintain absolute situational awareness and utilize defensive driving techniques to prevent accidents and mitigate security risks.
  • 10:00 AM - Asset Transfer: Act as the armed messenger. You will exit the vehicle to securely deliver and pick up cash deposits, coins, and valuable assets from retail clients and ATMs, operating with hyper-vigilance while your partner secures the perimeter.
  • 3:00 PM - Vault Reconciliation: Return safely to the branch facility. You will follow strict, heavily audited procedures to transfer the collected assets back into the vault and complete all digital and physical chain-of-custody paperwork.

The Security Advantage

This is a highly structured, rewarding role that combines commercial driving with elite physical security. You will enjoy a predictable daytime schedule. GardaWorld provides a highly competitive hourly wage, comprehensive medical and dental insurance, robust 401(k) options, and all necessary tactical and firearms training.

Qualifications

Must be at least 21 years of age. A valid driver's license with a pristine driving record is required (commercial license preferred but not always mandatory). You must possess or be willing and able to obtain a state-issued armed security guard license and a permit to carry a firearm. A flawless criminal background, exceptional ethical integrity, and the physical ability to lift heavy coin bags (up to 50 lbs) are mandatory.

jobs.description:
Job Overview
Top Gun Security & Investigations is seeking highly qualified "ARMED" security officers for assignments throughout Galveston, Harris, Fort Bend and Brazoria Counties. Candidates must have the following:
Active Texas Department of Public Safety Private Security Level 3 license
Reliable transportation
Approved firearm and related security officer equipment
Candidates will undergo a through interview, background and drug screening process prior to hiring.
JOIN the Top Gun Team!!!!!!!!!!

Duties

  • Monitor areas using CCTV surveillance systems
  • Perform patrol operations on foot or by vehicle
  • Control access points by verifying identification, issuing visitor badges, and managing entry logs for employees, contractors, visitors, and vendors.
  • Conduct thorough inspections of personnel, packages, and premises to prevent theft, vandalism, or unauthorized entry.
  • Respond promptly to security alarms or incidents, coordinating with law enforcement or emergency responders as necessary.
  • Maintain detailed incident reports, shift logs, and security records to document all activities accurately.
  • Utilize surveillance equipment such as CCTV cameras effectively to monitor activity across multiple locations.
  • Assist in conflict management by de-escalating tense situations with professionalism and tact.
  • Support emergency preparedness drills and ensure compliance with safety regulations at all times.

Skills

  • Proven experience in security roles, law enforcement, military service or related fields demonstrating strong situational awareness.
  • Knowledge of Texas laws as they pertain to Texas Security Officers
  • Knowledge of CCTV systems, surveillance techniques, and loss prevention methods.
  • Skilled in the use of firearms, defensive tactics, and intermediate weapons
  • Strong communications skills
  • Ability to effectively communicate with the public during non emergency and emergency situations

Conditions of Employment

  • Must be able to stand, walk and sit for extended periods (excess of 10hrs)
  • Must be able to work in all weather conditions
  • Must have reliable transportation
  • Must have reliable means of communication (employer utilizes this method for employees to clock in & out)
  • Must be able to remain on duty during critical situations
  • Must has a serviceable handgun (final determination will be that of the employer)
  • Must have all required equipment set forth by employer
  • Must have up to date ballistic vest when required (some assignments this is MANDATORY)
  • Must participate in all employer mandated training
  • Must maintain uniforms in a clean and serviceable manner
  • Must ensure all state issued license are current and renewed at least 30days prior to expiration

Pay: $18.00 - $19.00 per hour

License/Certification:

  • Level 3 Guard Card or Active Level 3 License (Required)

Shift availability:

  • Day Shift (Preferred)
  • Night Shift (Preferred)
  • Overnight Shift (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer - Decker Dr. in Baytown, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Chemical/Petrochemical, and more. As an Unarmed Patrol Officer at a chemical/petrochemical location, you will conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, support access control activities, and provide outstanding customer service. This driving position requires a valid driver’s license in the job state. Join Allied Universal’s agile, reliable, and innovative team, where a caring culture, teamwork, and integrity guide every interaction.

 Pay Rate: $14.00 / Hour

Valid Driver's License

  • Provide customer service to personnel, contractors and visitors by carrying out site-specific security-related procedures, access requirements and emergency response activities at a chemical/petrochemical location.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, spills, unusual conditions and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following established reporting and escalation protocols.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of buildings, operational areas, parking areas and the perimeter to help identify and report unauthorized activity, hazards or facility concerns.

  • Document patrol observations, incidents and shift activities in required reports, and communicate relevant information to Allied Universal leadership and site contacts.

Minimum Requirements

  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

jobs.title: Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Front Desk
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

Life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule. That’s why we created the Security Officer – Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.

As a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Front Desk in Houston, TX, this role is designed to provide reliable, consistent hours at an assigned site with the flexibility for you to earn more by picking-up additional shifts when it works for you.

Pay Rate: $15.50 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeWed02:00 PM - 06:00 PMThur02:00 PM - 06:00 PMFri02:00 PM - 06:00 PM

How This Role Works

  • Fixed-Shift Commitment (“Anchor Shifts”): You will be hired for a designated site and weekly shift that serves as your reliable base schedule. This assignment requires a six (6) month commitment.
  • Earn More, Claim-A-Shift Program: In addition to your fixed shift, you may pick-up extra shifts through our scheduling platform, allowing you to increase earnings and gain experience across multiple sites. Work part-time hours this week and full-time the next. It’s all up to you.

This role is ideal for candidates seeking part-time employment with flexibility, income stability, and opportunities to build-up to a full-time schedule of up to 40 hours per week; always with the option to scale back when needed.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer service to clients, visitors, and employees by carrying out site-specific security-related procedures and front desk policies at a chemical/petrochemical location.
  • Control access by greeting visitors, verifying credentials, issuing visitor badges, maintaining visitor logs, and directing authorized personnel to appropriate areas.
  • Monitor access points, alarms, cameras, and other security-related systems from the front desk, reporting unusual activity or equipment concerns according to site procedures.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following emergency response procedures and notifying appropriate personnel.
  • Maintain accurate records of visitor activity, deliveries, incidents, and other front desk communications while providing professional support to Allied Universal and site personnel.

Minimum Requirements

  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • Access control/badge experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.
